name: Vaults of the Inquisition and Road to De Other Side Heroic/Mythic templates hit a level 60 player as their logs
contract: The Heroic/Mythic templates (+100000/+200000) of both custom dungeons are level 60 and take no DestinyWeaver or dungeon multiplier, so their blow is the DamageModifier times 118.3 per point for class 1 and 112.4 for class 2 (open world, level 60 viewer, before armor). Mythic follows the 2026-08-05 Mythic logs: Inquisitorial Torturer (362733) 479, Merciless Echo (362700) 1261, The Deceiver's Presence (362704, class 2) 1921, Interstitial Wanderer (362765) 805. Heroic is Mythic / 2.5 for trash: Torturer (262733) 192. Before this, c = 857.1 per point was assumed and the Deceiver hit a level 60 player for 63 on Heroic (#10053).
